propositions: The concurrency overlay must be registered in OVERLAY_IDS enum before the workflow can escalate to it from base reviewer output

Content-triggered detection must scan added and removed diff lines for a high-precision token list (Mutex, RwLock, Lock, Semaphore, synchronized, volatile, @GuardedBy, Interlocked, pthread_, flock, fcntl, Thread, tokio::spawn, Task.Run, multiprocessing, asyncio.create_task, concurrent.futures, fork, sync.WaitGroup, atomic, advisory_lock, SERIALIZABLE, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and related concurrency primitives) and return concurrency overlay identifier
Routing configuration must specify advisory posture with 0.95 threshold and blocking disabled for concurrency overlay
Dispatch gates in code-review.yaml must wire concurrency overlay explicitly in both round_a and round_b batches using include_concurrency flag
